title: Chicken, Artichoke and Spinach Calzones with Feta and Basil
changes_from_base: Shredded cooked chicken, artichoke hearts, baby spinach, mozzarella, feta and basil go into two calzones in place of the ricotta filling.
summary: Substantial pastry envelopes hiding a filling of tender chicken, bright spinach, soft artichokes and two cheeses.

ingredients.item: cooked chicken, skin removed, shredded into bite-size pieces
frozen artichoke hearts, thawed, patted dry and chopped
fine sea salt or table salt
pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature

steps.title: Preheat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 230 °C with the shelf positioned in the upper middle section.

steps.title: Mix filling
steps.text: Put the shredded chicken, thawed and patted-dry chopped artichoke hearts, baby spinach, grated mozzarella, crumbled feta, chopped fresh basil, salt and ground black pepper into a large bowl and mix until evenly combined.

steps.title: Prepare dough
steps.text: Cut the pizza dough in half and roll each half on a lightly floured surface to a 23 cm round.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Pile half the filling over one half of each round, leaving a 2–3 cm border, brush the edge with water, fold the dough over and crimp tightly to seal.

steps.title: Place
steps.text: Brush the baking tray with 1 tbsp of olive oil and carefully lift the calzones onto it.

steps.title: Slash
steps.text: Cut two 2–3 cm slits in the top of each pastry parcel.

steps.title: Oil
steps.text: Brush the calzones all over with the remaining olive oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for about 20 min until golden brown.

tips: Pat the thawed artichoke hearts dry with kitchen paper so they don't release too much moisture into the filling.
Shred the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces rather than very small shreds—it will hold together better and taste less processed.
Line the tray with baking paper before oiling if you want easy cleanup; the paper prevents sticking just as well.
storage: Cool and chill within 2 hours; keeps for up to 2 days.
